# SSH Key Generator

> Free, open-source browser tool for generating Ed25519 and RSA SSH key pairs, preparing ssh-keygen commands, and building SSH client configuration.

Canonical website: https://sshkeygenerator.com/
Reference reviewed against repository content: 2026-11-04.

## Tool

- [SSH Key Generator](https://sshkeygenerator.com/): Interactive tool for Ed25519, RSA 2048-bit, and RSA 4096-bit key generation, public/private key export, and SHA256 fingerprints. Includes command and SSH configuration helpers.

Key-generation code runs in the browser using Web Crypto and local cryptographic libraries. The application does not upload generated private keys or passphrases. The hosted website also uses analytics and advertising; browser-local key generation is not a security certification. For environments that require local terminal generation, use OpenSSH ssh-keygen and follow your organization's policy.

## SSH guides by task

- [What is SSH?](https://sshkeygenerator.com/what-is-ssh/): Understand Secure Shell, its transport and authentication, and common uses.
- [What is an SSH key?](https://sshkeygenerator.com/what-is-an-ssh-key/): Understand public and private keys, fingerprints, passphrases, and authentication.
- [Generate an SSH key](https://sshkeygenerator.com/generate-ssh-key/): Choose a browser or local terminal workflow and create a key pair.
- [ssh-keygen command reference](https://sshkeygenerator.com/ssh-keygen/): Use OpenSSH key-generation flags, file paths, passphrases, and fingerprint commands.
- [Set up SSH access](https://sshkeygenerator.com/how-to-set-up-ssh/): Install a public key, configure an SSH client, and test authentication.
- [ssh command examples](https://sshkeygenerator.com/ssh-command/): Connect to hosts using identity files, custom ports, tunnels, and jump hosts.
- [Check a VPS public IP](https://sshkeygenerator.com/check-vps-ip/): Check the source IP of an outbound request from an existing SSH session; understand NAT and proxy limitations.

## Product behavior and limits

- RSA generation uses the browser Web Crypto API. Ed25519 generation uses @noble/ed25519. Generated key material is formatted for OpenSSH workflows; verify compatibility with the target client and platform.
- A key pair consists of a private key and a public key. Install only the public key on a server or Git hosting account, and keep the private key confidential.
- The application lets users copy or download keys and inspect SHA256 fingerprints. A downloaded file or clipboard copy remains under the user's device and browser controls.
- Generated private keys and passphrases are held in page memory rather than persisted in application local storage. Browser preferences and saved SSH host configurations are stored separately; see the privacy policy.
- The command helper prepares commands for execution in a user's terminal. The SSH configuration builder prepares text for a user's SSH client. The website does not connect to or configure a remote server on the user's behalf.
- The PWA caches application assets for offline use after a successful online installation. Initial loading and external documentation, analytics, and advertising require network access. Offline availability depends on the browser cache and previously loaded routes.
- Device compromise, browser extensions, third-party scripts, organizational security requirements, and handling of downloaded files must be considered separately. The repository's availability does not imply an independent audit of this application.

## Choosing a relevant page

Use the tool homepage for interactive browser key generation. Use /generate-ssh-key/ for choosing and following a generation workflow, /ssh-keygen/ for command flags and key management, /ssh-command/ for remote connections and tunnels, and /how-to-set-up-ssh/ for installing a public key and testing login. The two definition guides explain SSH and key-pair concepts. The VPS IP guide addresses an already connected server's outbound public IP; it does not establish inbound reachability.

Every guide has the same slug under its language prefix. For example, the Japanese ssh command guide is https://sshkeygenerator.com/ja/ssh-command/ and the Simplified Chinese key-generation guide is https://sshkeygenerator.com/zh-Hans/generate-ssh-key/.

## Primary technical references

- [OpenSSH ssh-keygen manual](https://man.openbsd.org/ssh-keygen): Key generation, passphrase changes, public-key extraction, and fingerprint options.
- [OpenSSH ssh manual](https://man.openbsd.org/ssh): Remote connections, identity files, forwarding, and jump hosts.
- [OpenSSH ssh_config manual](https://man.openbsd.org/ssh_config): SSH client configuration options.
- [GitHub SSH documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/connecting-to-github-with-ssh): GitHub's key registration and connection requirements.
- [GitLab SSH documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/ssh/): GitLab's supported keys and account configuration.
- [curl manual](https://curl.se/docs/manpage.html): HTTP requests, proxy behavior, and IPv4/IPv6 options used by the VPS IP guide.

This reference describes this application's content and behavior. It does not establish search rankings, observed assistant citations, third-party endorsements, or a guarantee of privacy, security, indexing, or availability.
